name: Fenmark GhostTouch Infiltration Glove
description: Skintight matte-black biopolymer glove that reads as near-zero on surface scanners. The palm and fingertip pads are layered with micro-suction gecko-fiber for silent vertical grip. A thin electroactive polymer layer across the fingertips actively randomizes dermal print output, cycling through stored ghost-prints every 4.3 seconds. Cut-away option at index and middle finger available for augmented digit users. No branding — a small embossed triangle on the inner wrist is the only mark.
functionality: Print-masking via cycling ghost-print electroactive layer. Gecko-fiber grip rated for smooth glass and wet metal. Scanner-low biopolymer shell. Cut-away finger option for augmented digits. Silent surface contact.
what_it_says: Whatever you're about to do, you've done it before and you didn't get caught.
story_hooks: A ghost-print cycle on a recovered glove is being forensically decoded — whoever's prints are stored in it shouldn't be alive anymore.
Fenmark's gecko-fiber supplier is a Tier 1 bio-fab operation; someone is trying to trace the supply chain to shut it down.
A CorpSec analyst notices the same ghost-print cycling pattern at three separate breach sites — the gloves are all from the same batch.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gecko Ascender GA-4

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist glove that disappears against skin tone, creating an almost second-skin appearance. The matte finish absorbs light rather than reflecting it, giving an impression of void-like quality. Worn tight to the hand without excess material, it conveys precision and purpose.
physical_description.fit: Skintight compression fit, conforming exactly to hand geometry. No bunching at knuckles or wrists. Designed for dexterity and tactile feedback rather than comfort or insulation.
physical_description.primary_material: Biopolymer (matte-black, scanner-dampening grade). Micro-suction gecko-fiber composite on palm and fingertips. Thin electroactive polymer layer embedded in fingertip pads.
physical_description.texture: Outer surface: ultra-smooth, almost frictionless matte finish. Palm/fingertips: barely perceptible raised micro-texture from gecko-fiber matrix. Feels almost organic when worn.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep matte black with no contrast. Inner wrist features a single small embossed triangle (Φ-grade minimalist branding) in barely-visible relief.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit only; no zippers, snaps, or clasps. Designed to slip on and adhere via biopolymer grip at wrist.
distinctive_features: Electroactive polymer fingertips that cycle ghost-prints every 4.3 seconds to defeat biometric scanning
Gecko-fiber micro-suction pads for silent vertical grip and wall-scaling
Cut-away option at index and middle finger for chrome-augmented users
Scanner-dampening biopolymer construction reads as near-zero thermal/electrical signature
Minimal branding: only embossed triangle on inner wrist
No visible seams or construction lines
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4 (working-class street tech) — affordable infiltration-grade, black-market origin, not corpo-exclusive
physical_description.cultural_context: Street operatives, runners, thieves, industrial saboteurs, activists. Signals capability and intent to bypass security. Worn by those who need to move unseen through scanned spaces.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; develops subtle wear patterns on fingertips and palm from repeated use. May show faint smudges or micro-scuffs but resists visible damage due to material durability.
